title: Natural Gas or a Heat Pump? Where You Live Matters - American Gas Association
summary: American Gas Association (2024): gas furnaces cost less to run than heat pumps in 41 states, cost less to install, and emit less.

assertions.quote: natural gas is more affordable in 41 out of 50 states when comparing ENERGY STAR natural gas furnaces to ENERGY STAR electric heat pumps.
where you live says a lot about what type of heating is going to be most affordable in the long term.
The colder (or hotter) it is, the harder it has to work to make that happen, and the more electricity it takes.
New heat pumps typically cost between $2,500 and $10,000 to install
you may also need to pay to have it rewired for additional electrical capacity
a natural gas ENERGY STAR household can have a carbon footprint 19% lower than an ENERGY STAR heat pump household
